requests.prompt: Editorial portrait photograph of the same man from Picture 1. Keep him completely unchanged: identical face and facial features, identical hairstyle and hairline, identical freckles and natural skin texture, identical calm closed-mouth expression, identical straight-on gaze into the camera, identical blue earbud, identical black jacket and white t-shirt. Change only the background and the framing: replace the entire outdoor street background with a smooth seamless warm cream-paper studio backdrop (approximately #F4F0E9) with a very subtle paper grain and a faint soft shadow behind the shoulders. IMPORTANT FRAMING, follow exactly: a medium close-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, NOT a tight face close-up; the head must occupy only about one third of the frame height; leave generous empty cream space above the head and on both sides; both shoulders visible; the subject centred; straight-on eye-level camera; natural 50mm perspective without wide-angle distortion. Soft diffused studio light from the upper left, warm muted palette, photorealistic, sharp eyes, no text, no props, no extra people, no neon, no vignette.
